sourceCode: const page = $context.$nodes.FETCH_PBCS_BATCH_PAGE.$output; const state = $context.$variables.batchState; if (!page || !Array.isArray(page.items) || typeof page.hasMore !== 'boolean') { throw new Error('Journal batch service returned an invalid page.'); } if (page.offset !== state.offset) { throw new Error('Journal batch service returned an unexpected page offset.'); } if (page.hasMore && page.items.length === 0) { throw new Error('Journal batch service reported more results without advancing pagination.'); } return {offset: state.offset + page.items.length, hasMore: page.hasMore, items: state.items.concat(page.items), pages: state.pages + 1};
